subject: maths
question: A conical shape vessel has a radius of 21 cm and has a slant height of 25 cm. If the curved part of the vessel is to be painted white, find the cost (in Rs.) of painting at the rate of Rs. 1.5 per cm².
solution:
Given:

Slant Height of conical shape = 25 cm 

Radius of conical shape = 21cm

Formula used:

The curved surface area of the conical shape of vessel = πrl

Diameter = 2r 

Calculation:

The curved surface area of the conical shape of vessel × cost of painting = πrl × cost of painting

⇒ (22/7)× 21 × 25 × 1.5 

⇒ 2475

**∴The cost of painting at the rate of Rs. 1.5 per cm2 is 2475.**
